name: LD06 Raspberry Pi Development Kit
summary: LD06 sensor development accessory kit with bracket, UART cable and assembly screws, intended for evaluation and robotics education with a separately purchased Raspberry Pi.

description.en: LD06 sensor development accessory kit with bracket, UART cable and assembly screws, intended for evaluation and robotics education with a separately purchased Raspberry Pi.

specs.label: Sensor and accessory set
specs.value: bracket & DTOF module & Uart cable & Assembly screws
specs.conditions: Kit accessories listed in manufacturer manual. Raspberry Pi host purchased separately.

sources.title: LD06 Raspberry Pi User Manual v2.9
sources.quote:
The development kit of DTOF LiDAR_LD06 is an accessory tool (includes
bracket & DTOF module & Uart cable & Assembly screws) provided for robotic
device development or performance evaluation of sensor products, and for the
educational purpose use of robotic device motion control and algorithm study,
Users need to purchase a RPI SBC ( Raspberry PI3 A+/B+                      ,  Raspberry PI3 B,
Raspberry PI 4B) to pair with DTOF module for use/development.

specs.formatted: bracket & DTOF module & Uart cable & Assembly screws

specs.label: Supported host platforms
specs.value: Raspberry Pi 3 A+, Raspberry Pi 3 B+, Raspberry Pi 3 B, Raspberry Pi 4 B
specs.conditions: Raspberry Pi single-board computer must be purchased separately; complete list from manual development-kit paragraph.
